💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
